description: Search Jobs Every Hour: open jobs in every field: healthcare, engineering, sales, skilled trades, retail, office, education, government and more, mostly in the United States, plus remote jobs and jobs in many other countries. Every job is read from the employer's own careers page (US federal jobs from USAJOBS), and the lists are read again around the clock, so a job the employer takes down leaves the results. Words are matched in the title, company, skills, place and text of each posting, best match first, e.g. 'registered nurse houston', 'entry level accounting', 'warehouse night shift' or 'python remote'. The word 'remote' (or remote_only) keeps remote jobs only. Each result has the place, the pay when the posting states it, the posting date and the job's page.

query.description: Words to look for: a role, skill, company or place, e.g. 'entry level nurse texas' or 'customer service remote'
